title: What will the paper look like after the cut is opened?
description: A sheet of paper is folded once and a notch is cut along a dotted line that starts at the fold. Opening the sheet shows the notch and its mirror picture joined at the fold. Keeko's doubt is that the hole is only the one notch.
teaching_notes: One idea: a cut through a folded sheet goes through every layer, so the opened sheet shows the cut and its mirror picture, and the fold is the line of symmetry. Watch for students who draw only one notch.

source: In two pictures, a sheet of paper is folded and a cut is mad
video_script.why: The child sees that a cut through a folded sheet is repeated across the fold, so the opened paper is symmetric about the fold.
video_script.substitution: A cut goes through both layers of the folded sheet, so the second layer holds the mirror picture of the first.
video_script.anchor: a sheet of paper folded once, with a notch-shaped cut along a dotted line that starts at the fold
video_script.wrong_answer: the hole is only the one notch
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says the hole is only the one notch, so only one notch should be drawn. Opening the sheet shows a second notch on the other half, because the cut went through two layers.
video_script.payoff_line: The notch and its mirror picture join at the fold, which is the line of symmetry

final_answer.value: The hole is the cut and its mirror image joined along the fold; the fold is the line of symmetry
final_answer.spoken: the hole is the notch and its mirror picture joined along the fold, and the fold is the line of symmetry

hold_back: the notch and its mirror picture
maths_rules: A sheet folded once has 2 layers
A cut along the dotted line goes through both layers, so it makes 2 notches
The second notch is the mirror picture of the first across the fold
The two halves of the opened sheet cover each other when folded along the fold line, so the fold is the line of symmetry
video_script.design: One idea: a cut through a folded sheet is repeated across the fold as a mirror picture. The folded sheet stays on the board until it is opened. Wrong idea: the hole is only one notch.
